capabilities: Rename installed plugins' display names with custom text, emoji, prefixes or suffixes
Lock names so they are reapplied after plugin updates replace manifest.json
Batch rename or unlock multiple plugins, including template-based naming
Restore original or community registry names while keeping custom text for reuse
Search and filter plugins by ID, current name, custom name or community name
disambiguation: Not a plugin-ID or file-extension changer; it only edits the display names shown in Obsidian.
extras: Manual installation only (download main.js, manifest.json, styles.css from releases); automatic restore relies on Obsidian's internal plugin installation hook and may break if that API changes; the plugin ID changed from custom-extension-names to plugin-name-locker and upgrading requires migrating the folder while keeping data.json.
problem: Obsidian takes plugin display names from each plugin's manifest.json, so hand-edited names are overwritten whenever a plugin updates.
summary: Plugin manager that renames the display names of installed plugins and can restore those names after plugin updates.
